title: Summability for State Integrals of hyperbolic knots
note: arXiv:2410.20973. PROVES the Garoufalidis–Gu–Mariño conjecture that the perturbative (trivial-connection) series of the hyperbolic knots 4₁ and 5₂ are resurgent and Borel summable, and gives an algorithm computing the Borel–Laplace (median) resummation explicitly as the Andersen–Kashaev state integral, with explicit Stokes constants. Directly on-point for the QOU c₃-via-Borel route: 4₁ is the muon anchor and 5₂ is the saddle source (PR #4408 canonical saddle values, #4414 q-Borel Lean chain). The state-integral = Borel-Laplace identity is the closed-form target the median_borel_resummation probe approximates numerically; the Stokes constants are the A_ω integers of bean qou-4iy0 / qou-3s30. Registered 2026-08-01 (c₃-via-Borel literature sweep).
